policy: A shared bitmap exists only when an independent high-quality source is already present. Frozen page screenshots are not cropped into production assets.

category_decisions.reason: A clean 1080×1920 Morning Lake scene master now exists. It was produced by removing only UI, rod, line, bobber and ripple regions from the frozen Empty Home scene, with no scene redesign.
category_decisions.implementation: Use Morning_Lake_Master_V1 with BG_ENV_HERO, BG_CONTENT or BG_DATA treatment. Do not crop frozen page screenshots into new backgrounds.

category_decisions.reason: The capture button is a shared component made from tokens and a vector glyph, not a screenshot-derived image.
category_decisions.implementation: YuJianPrimaryCaptureButton using native Compose and vector rendering.

category_decisions.reason: Legibility gradients, mist glass, pills, borders, shadows, and separators are parameterized visual treatments.
category_decisions.implementation: Native Compose surfaces and token-driven gradients; do not export screenshot crops.

category_decisions.reason: Fish photographs, record covers, thumbnails, and fish-guide subjects are dynamic or page-specific content, not global static assets.
category_decisions.implementation: Runtime media/data source or separately approved source master when one becomes available.
